_comment: Machine-readable metadata for the DRISHTI foundational synthetic vitals dataset.
generation_purpose: Bootstrap training data for DRISHTI/PHC SaMD offline AI correlation kernel (IIT Indore, Prof. Banda, HarSaRK). To be replaced by real data upon CDSCO/government API access.

glucose_prediabetes_min.source: RSSDI / ICMR-INDIAB random (non-fasting) glucose screening criterion
glucose_prediabetes_min.note: Distinct from fasting glucose criteria (100/126) -- do not conflate with biometrics.yml's generation bins, see note in glucose_generation_bins.

glucose_diabetes_min.source: WHO/ADA criterion, adopted in ICMR-INDIAB opportunistic screening

glucose_generation_bins.note: Controls what raw glucose value Synthea draws for patients its own diabetes_severity module already tagged normal/prediabetic/diabetic -- NOT the classification threshold applied by this pipeline (see glucose_prediabetes_min/glucose_diabetes_min above). Widened from an earlier fasting-style [70,100,126,200] because that shape caused glucose_high to realize in <1.1% of draws under a random-glucose classification threshold.

adults_age_gte_18.note: AHA 2017 >=130 mmHg SBP cutoff is explicitly NOT used. IHCI >=140 is the source.

bmi.note: IAP 2015 growth chart-based BMI labeling deferred. Requires lookup table data/iap_bmi_percentiles.csv. Re-run step3 when table is available. No Synthea regeneration needed.

glucose.note: Same 140/200 mg/dL random-glucose cutoff as adults, no age-gating

icd_candidate.description: Specific ICD-10 code. Null where combination does not narrow below block level — not an error. Null rows handled by LLM/retrieval Layer 2.

differential_candidates.description: Pipe-separated ranked list, at icd_block granularity

symptom_signal_strength.description: Confidence-basis training signal for Layer 1. Feeds physician-verification banner. Independently queryable per ISO 14971 H-01-H-10 series.
symptom_signal_strength.note: Labels are based on pre-noise values and are not recalculated after noise injection (step6).

label_architecture.source_of_labels: abnormal_params combinations mapped via config.py ICD_MAPPING table (resolved via config.resolve_condition) — NOT from Synthea disease modules

weighted_multi_candidate_resolution.description: Rev 6: some ICD_MAPPING entries map a frozenset key to a weighted list of candidate conditions instead of one flat condition, for keys where no vital-sign fingerprint distinguishes the candidates (e.g. isolated pulse_high could be sinus_tachycardia, anxiety, anemia, or hyperthyroidism). config.resolve_condition() deterministically selects one candidate per row via a stable SHA-256 hash of (patient_id, encounter_date, salt), so the same row always resolves the same way, and step3 (labeling) and step4 (symptom/drug sampling) never disagree on which condition was selected.
weighted_multi_candidate_resolution.fever_pattern_signal: A synthetic epidemiological routing flag (config.assess_fever_pattern), NOT a measured vital -- ~8% base rate, ~22% during monsoon (Jun-Sep). Exists because a 6-vital system has no channel to carry infectious-disease signal; without it, malaria/dengue/typhoid/chikungunya/UTI/gastroenteritis/TB/LRTI could never realize as a primary icd_candidate. Excluded from tier/_param_count.

tiers._comment: Tiers 5/6 (5-6 simultaneous abnormal vitals) occur at <0.001% in Synthea's baseline generation for ambulatory PHC visits — judged clinically implausible to synthetically inject rather than observe, so the tier scheme was collapsed to 4 to reflect only distributions that occur through genuine simulated pathways.

tier4.note: High acuity ceiling -- merges >=3 abnormal params

glucose.source: Glucometer/point-of-care measurement error, ~10 mg/dL conservative end of ISO 15197 accuracy band

demographics_reweighting._comment: Rev 6: Synthea's demographic generator is US-pattern by default; no India demographics/geography module exists in synthea-international/in (unlike de/fr/gb/etc). Corrected post-hoc in step2b_demographic_reweight.py rather than in Synthea itself.

target_age_sex_distribution.source: Approximate Census 2011 broad age-band population shares, renormalized to the pipeline's 5-80 age window. Precision not required for a synthetic bootstrap dataset.

demographics_reweighting.method: Accumulate a raw pool ~4x (RAW_POOL_MULTIPLIER) the target row count, then resample per age-decade x sex cell to match the target shares -- with replacement for under-represented cells (typically elderly bands), without replacement (downsample) for over-represented ones.

disease_coverage._comment: Rev 6: full list of condition_tag/icd_candidate pairs introduced or restructured, for ISO 14971 traceability. 'resolution' is either 'flat' (single unique ICD_MAPPING key) or 'weighted_multi_candidate' (shares a key with sibling conditions, selected via config.resolve_condition).

pediatric_safety.invariant: age_at_encounter < 18 => drug_name='None' AND drug_dosage='None' AND pediatric_referral_flag=true, regardless of resolved condition
pediatric_safety.enforcement: Blanket override in step4_symptom_pairing.py::run() (not per-condition), independently hard-fail-checked (AssertionError) in step5_aggregate.py::run() and run_pipeline.py::run_spot_checks()
pediatric_safety.history_note: This invariant's supporting columns (drug_name/drug_dosage/pediatric_referral_flag) were dropped once from a prior dataset rebuild that only re-ran the noise-injection step without re-running the full label pipeline -- hence the double hard-fail check.

columns.name: glucose
columns.note: Random/non-fasting. Opportunistic and sparser than bmi; deliberately NOT imputed when missing

columns.name: fever_pattern_flag
columns.note: Synthetic epidemiological routing signal, NOT a measured vital

columns.name: icd_candidate
columns.note: Null by design for rows below block precision
